Based upon the results of that assessment, if the carrying value of our goodwill exceeds its fair value, (i) the recorded goodwill will be written down and (ii) a non-cash impairment expense will be recorded in the Consolidated Statements of Operations.

If near-term profitability trends, or our long-term profitability outlook, decline below our expectations, it is possible that an interim assessment, or a future annual assessment, could result in an additional impairment of our goodwill.

estimates.name: Goodwill – Net
estimates.t: As discussed in our 2025 Form 10-K, during the year ended December 31, 2025, we determined that the estimated fair value of the Marketplace Reporting Unit was lower than its carrying value.
estimates.effect: Consequently, during the year ended December 31, 2025, we recognized a non-cash impairment expense of $660.7 million related to our goodwill, $297.4 million of which was recognized as of June 30, 2025 and $363.3 million of which was recognized as of October 31, 2025.

estimates.name: Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets
estimates.t: As discussed in our 2025 Form 10-K, during the year ended December 31, 2025, we determined that the estimated fair value of certain indefinite-lived trademarks was lower than their carrying value.
estimates.effect: Consequently, during the year ended December 31, 2025, we recognized a non-cash impairment expense of $62.3 million related to certain indefinite-lived trademarks, $23.0 million of which was recognized as of June 30, 2025 and $39.3 million of which was recognized as of October 31, 2025.
